description: You can combine existing list operations to keep everything before the last item.

steps.description: cxr accepts one list as l.
Read from the inside out: reverse l, take cdr to drop its first item, then reverse again.

steps.answer: The original last item, 5, becomes the first item of the reversed list and is dropped.
steps.question: Which original item will be absent from this call's result?

steps.description: The displayed result is (1 2 3 4). cxr composes existing functions without a recursive call of its own.

title: Drop the last item by composition
